summary.headline: Combustion, Exaltation, and Eclipse
summary.text: Chapters 38–40 discuss planetary combustion and emergence from under the rays, Saturn’s exaltation, planetary testimony and aspects from fixed, movable, and common signs, and an eclipse occurring in the same year.
